visual_authority.failure_condition: Any mutation to the accepted shovel artwork is failure. New capability must compile around this exact parent.

historical_generation_source.note: Preserve untouched. It is not used to authorize or rebuild accepted pixels.

runtime.assembly: five SHA-locked chunks concatenated exactly; builder rejects any mismatch
runtime.rendering: SVG affine projection of quaternion-rotated vector layers; no Canvas, WebGL, CSS 3D, raster, or runtime AI

interaction_contract.drag_assembled: after threshold, pull only touched part free
interaction_contract.reference_layout: separate all four accepted parts as independent 3D vectors
interaction_contract.assemble: restore exact frozen accepted whole-object frame
interaction_contract.move: one-finger planar drag on selected free part
interaction_contract.rotate: one-finger free virtual trackball: pitch, yaw, and roll with quaternion state
interaction_contract.scale: one-finger vertical drag; shrink/grow selected free part
interaction_contract.edge_on_accessibility: after selection, Rotate and Scale may use the whole workspace so an edge-on part remains manipulable
interaction_contract.scroll: none; complete interface fits one phone viewport
interaction_contract.keyboard: arrows move/pitch/yaw, Q/E roll, arrows scale, R reset, Esc assemble, Space reference
